description: Reviewed routes outside the command registry (spec 0006 §6.5). aq-server's route test fails on any mounted route that is neither a registered command route nor listed here. Adding a route here needs review.

classes.command: Served through the command registry: a registered command route, or the command surface itself.
classes.node: Node and worker protocol, authenticated by the node credential.
classes.agent_legacy: agent-access-1 /v1/agent/* routes kept until spec 0006 §9 retires them.
classes.owner_admin: Owner administration and REST mutations outside the command surface.
